rationale: Evaluator feedback on the last candidate recommended increasing kd from 0.15 to 0.2 to improve damping and reduce steering oscillations, changing line_loss strategy from 'last_direction' to 'search_left' to enhance recovery from line loss events, and slightly increasing base_speed from 0.7 to 0.75 to balance stability and speed. I implemented these changes while keeping kp at 0.5 and ki at 0.02 to maintain a soft proportional response and low integral windup risk. Sensor weights remain softened at [-0.35, 0.45, -0.35] to avoid overcorrection. These adjustments aim to reduce oscillations and improve line loss recovery without sacrificing progress. I request telemetry on steering_oscillation and line_loss_events to verify these hypotheses and guide further tuning if needed.
